_schema.description: Structured record of every non-running session: what was actually done, set by set, plus how it felt. Companion to training-actuals.json (which holds runs). Query with scripts/strength-history.py.

session_fields.label: human-readable name
session_fields.device: duration_min / avg_hr / max_hr / cal / training_load, if the session was recorded on a watch
session_fields.exercises: list of {name, sets:[{reps, load_kg|hold_s, note}], note}
session_fields.confidence: 'reported' = athlete gave set-by-set detail; 'prescribed' = only loads confirmed, sets assumed from the plan

_watchpoints._note: Standing weaknesses and targets carried from session to session. strength-history.py --brief <session> prints the relevant ones before every session. Add as they appear; update as they improve; delete when fixed.
